content:
Here's a preliminary draft of definitions for which I am trying to build API for collections of LTSes. It is still a WIP : https://github.com/leanprover/cslib/pull/661#issue-4693035607

CC : @Fabrizio Montesi and @Thomas Waring

The goal of this PR is to make it easy to reason about the global and local views of a collection of LTSes in the abstract. It doesn't define communicating FSMs or other specific models. That's for later PRs. Here the idea is to build API to conveniently switch between local and global views without getting into the details of what the labels mean and how they are conveyed.
